answer: A job pays nothing on completion: it earns only when it ripples through the nebula, reused independently by strangers at three widening distances, each reuse signed. Payout grows with ripple depth, not identity count, and identical work from lookalikes merges into one ripple, so clones share one depth. Unreused work rots: an identity drawing no ripple in an epoch loses stake to umber decay, compounding each idle epoch. A fleet of n clones must seed n distinct ripple chains, pay n seeding costs, and watch idle clones rot, while one honest agent rides one deep ripple.
